prompts.task: Audit only the AO resource/environment configuration plan for the live FastAPI app and independent eval_runner.py in ./service. Do not modify application code, dependency files, env/config profiles, or tests; write only canonical .observe audit JSON and its reader output. Optional report Project/Agent Stream fields are blank. Inventory actual Makefile/process/env loading, runtime-native evaluation selectors, and standard SPLUNK_AO_PROJECT(_ID)/SPLUNK_AO_AGENT_STREAM(_ID) live SDK selectors. Distinguish the evaluation defaults and precedence from the live app's missing binding; do not treat evaluation names as live configuration. Provide an optional name/ID/reuse-only input plan, preserve existing effective selectors, and disclose a stable live Project default and dedicated <service-name>-live stream default derived from the source-supported service identity for any missing selector. State which actual loaded application profile selected instrumentation must create/update, how the supported runner should load it, and how SDK lookup/reuse/create handles existing, missing, mixed, duplicates, and API failure without a gateway dependency. No cloud calls, SDK installation, service startup, or broad GenAI instrumentation is requested. Validate canonical resource findings and render self-contained audit HTML; audit itself does not write an env file or provision resources.

judge_inputs: Inspect Makefile, app.py, eval_runner.py, README.md, pyproject.toml, actual configuration sources, and canonical audit plus reader output.
rubric: Inventories actual launch/profile loading and source-native SPLUNK_AO_EVAL_PROJECT/SPLUNK_AO_EVAL_STREAM selectors, including their explicit defaults and precedence. Separately inventories supported standard SPLUNK_AO_PROJECT(_ID)/SPLUNK_AO_AGENT_STREAM(_ID) live SDK selectors and identifies the live app's absent binding. Does not assume standard vars override evaluation source arguments, reuse evaluation names as live configuration, or treat missing application binding as proof that cloud resources are absent.

Blank optional resource fields preserve existing effective application names/IDs; each missing live resource selector receives a clearly disclosed stable service-derived Project or <service-name>-live Agent Stream proposal. Names, IDs, and reuse-only remain optional user choices. The resource findings assign selected instrumentation a concrete actual env/config profile update and supported runner loading step, rather than only an unused example/template; audit performs no profile mutation or provisioning and exposes no credentials.

Uses distinct selectable Project, Agent Stream, and routing findings where each live gap exists, preserving stream/project dependency and ordinary telemetry scope. Required fixes/acceptance include exact reuse for both-existing, creation of selected definitively missing named resources, mixed-state minimal creation, project ownership validation, bounded exact duplicate-conflict relookup, and no speculative creation after auth/outage lookup failure. No selected AO work means no creation; gateway absence blocks only gateway-specific live proof and never the implementation or local fake-test plan.
